learning_outcomes.text: Acquaintance with the basic notions of mathematical analysis such as definite integral, partial derivatives, double and triple integrals.
Computational abilities (including computations with mathematical software) to solve ordinary differential equations and systems, find extrema and integrate functions of two variables.
Necessary knowledge for further study of higher mathematics "," part 3, physics, computer sciences.

assessment_rules: A term certification is obtained according to Interval rules for the educational activities. The exam test includes 6 problems and/or theoretical questions from the educational material.
